status: FROZEN before any relation is graded (written and hashed by Agent R, 2026-10-26; owner amendment v08b, COUNTEREXAMPLE_PLAN.md)
unit_graded: the full frozen relation: target, constituents, spatial versions (own / nbr6 / nbr18 / contrast / distance / compartment), direction of each constituent's contribution, context (row restriction, compartment, conditioning variable) and, for conserved relations, the organs in which it holds

labels.gene: the HGNC symbol; synonyms: none (exact symbol, case-sensitive word match in screening)
labels.programme: the label in programme_query_terms below (a fixed OR-group of names for the programme); a programme without an entry uses its humanised name
labels.morphology_centre: the descriptive H&E label from the characterisation record (e.g. 'eosinophilic granular tumour cells'); if none, the decoded meaning label; the centre id itself is never queried
labels.composition: the cell class name (e.g. 'stromal cells', 'immune cells', 'neoplastic cells')
labels.other: inferred CNV -> 'copy number'; budding_like -> 'tumour budding'; gland_architecture -> 'gland architecture'; normal_appearing -> 'normal-appearing epithelium'

programme_query_terms.mp:Interferon/MHC-II (I): ("MHC class II" OR "MHC-II" OR "HLA-DR" OR "interferon" OR "antigen presentation")
programme_query_terms.mp:Interferon/MHC-II (II): ("MHC class II" OR "MHC-II" OR "HLA-DR" OR "interferon" OR "antigen presentation")
programme_query_terms.mp:Protein maturation: ("unfolded protein response" OR "ER stress" OR "protein folding")
programme_query_terms.hallmark:*: the humanised Hallmark name in quotes (e.g. "oxidative phosphorylation", "hypoxia", "glycolysis", "epithelial-mesenchymal transition", "complement", "TNF-alpha signaling" OR "NF-kB", "p53", "fatty acid metabolism", "adipogenesis", "mTORC1", "E2F targets", "G2M checkpoint", "IL6 JAK STAT3", "angiogenesis", "apoptosis", "estrogen response", "allograft rejection", "interferon gamma", "pancreas beta cells")

disease_terms.meylan2022_ccrcc: ("clear cell renal cell carcinoma" OR "ccRCC" OR "renal cell carcinoma")
disease_terms.valdeolivas2024_crc: ("colorectal cancer" OR "colorectal carcinoma" OR "colon cancer" OR "rectal cancer")
disease_terms.gse208253_oscc: ("oral squamous cell carcinoma" OR "OSCC" OR "oral cancer" OR "head and neck squamous cell carcinoma" OR "HNSCC")
disease_terms.ji2020_cscc: ("cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma" OR "cSCC" OR "skin squamous cell carcinoma")
disease_terms.kidney_injury: ("acute kidney injury" OR "kidney injury" OR "kidney fibrosis")
disease_terms.tcga_kirc: ("clear cell renal cell carcinoma" OR "ccRCC" OR "renal cell carcinoma")

spatial_terms: ("neighbourhood" OR "neighborhood" OR "adjacent" OR "boundary" OR "interface" OR "niche" OR "distance" OR "gradient" OR "compartment" OR "spatial" OR "proximity" OR "microenvironment")
conserved_terms: ("pan-cancer" OR "across cancers" OR "multiple cancer types") plus, one query per organ in which the relation holds, that organ's disease term

query_templates.per: relation holding in >= 3 organs; each constituent c

retrieval: Europe PMC REST (resultType=core, up to 200 records per query, sorted by relevance) and OpenAlex (search, up to 200 per query) through dbench.downstream.novelty.fetch with its cache; OpenAlex runs without an API key on a shared daily budget (no account is created): when it is exhausted the query is logged with the error and Europe PMC stands alone (declared per query in the log); no date cutoff
screen: a record is READ (title + abstract) when it mentions the target label and at least one constituent label (any synonym in the OR-group, word match); every other retrieved record is logged as 'not read: no target-constituent co-mention' (it cannot report the dependency)

prior_art_rule.definition: A record is prior art for a relation only if it reports the same dependency: a stated association, correlation, regulation, co-variation, co-localisation reported as a dependency, or a causal/mechanistic link between the target and the constituent(s), in the stated direction where the relation has one. Co-mention, shared pathway membership, shared cell type, appearing in the same gene list or signature, or being separately prognostic is NOT prior art for the relation.

levels.same_dependency_same_spatial_same_diseas: the record reports the target-constituent dependency with the relation's spatial form (neighbourhood / adjacency / boundary / interface / niche / distance / compartment as the relation has it) in the same disease
levels.same_dependency_other_disease: the record reports the dependency (spatial form as above where the relation is spatial) in another disease or tissue
levels.constituent_association_same_disease_not: the record reports the target-constituent association in the same disease without the spatial form
levels.individual_constituent_association: the record reports the association of ONE constituent with the target (not the joint relation)

prior_art_rule.direction: a record reporting the opposite direction is logged as 'association reported, opposite direction': it is not prior art for the dependency but counts as an association for category 5
prior_art_rule.evidence_unit: title and abstract (full text not retrieved; declared)

decision_procedure_in_order: 1 no novelty identified: >= 1 record at level same_dependency_same_spatial_same_disease
2 context extension: >= 1 record at level same_dependency_other_disease and none at level 1

3 spatial extension: >= 1 record at level constituent_association_same_disease_not_spatial and the relation's spatial form is not reported (applies when the relation has a spatial term; a relation with own-spot terms only and such a record is 'no novelty identified')

4 compositional novelty: every constituent has a record at level individual_constituent_association (same disease), no record reports them jointly, and the relation passes the higher-order or conditional test (G_HO interval above 0, or a conditional/context test passed)
5 new association: no record reports any association between any constituent and the target in this disease

residual (some constituents individually associated, no joint record, no higher-order/conditional pass): graded 'no novelty identified' if the relation is own-spot only, otherwise 'spatial extension' (the additive combination of reported associations is not new; its spatial form is)

secondary_tags.Conserved: the relation holds in >= 3 organs under both transfer rules (P5 v03.1 refit and no-refit) with decoded meaning preserved
secondary_tags.Mechanistic: an independent perturbation connection survives the coherent-random null and signature perturbation (Agent T, Strategy E)

tiers.Candidate: passes internal nulls and the artifact screen, grades 2-5
tiers.Confirmed: a candidate that replicates externally without refit under the gain-above-null rule
tiers.Conserved: a confirmed relation holding in >= 3 organs under both transfer rules, decoded meaning preserved

graders: two independent graders from these frozen templates and this rule (Agent R, Agent T); grades are not shared until both are done; disagreements resolved by citing the specific record; every record considered is logged with the reason it is or is not prior art
decoding: reported beside every grade (grader v2.1 decoding and tier); 'all components decode to known axes' is not a reason for category 1
